steps.details: equimolar amounts of transition metal diethyldithiocarbamate precursors dissolved in a minimum volume of dichloromethane

evidence.text_snippet: equimolar amounts (0.1 mmol per precursor) of transition metal diethyldithiocarbamate precursors, M(S2CNEt2)x (where M = C r ,M n ,F e ,C o ,N i ,C u ,Z n a n d x= 2 o r 3 ) , were dissolved in a minimum volume of dichloromethane.

steps.details: solvent allowed to evaporate, leaving mixed precursors powder

evidence.text_snippet: The solvent was allowed to evaporate, leaving a powder of mixed precursors.

steps.details: heated to 900 °C at 15 °C min-1 ramp rate in static air, held for 4 h

evidence.text_snippet: heated to 900°C( 1 5°C m i n−1 ramp rate) whilst exposed to static air, then held for 4 h
The lattice parameter decreased as the number of metals increased with the lattice parameter determined for the 7 metal HESO as 8.33 Å.
allowed for a lattice parameter determination of 8.32± 0.1 Å for the 7-metal HESO
The 7-metal HESO showed a T 10 value of 168 °C
and a T50 value of 250 °C
which was a 63% decrease compared to the 4-metal MESO (at 454°C)
which was 56% lower than the 5-metal HESO (at 569 °C)
The activity of commercially sourced Fe 3O4 was also evaluated as a comparison and was found to have an intermediate T50 of 371 °C.
Overall, the 4-metal spinel oxide degraded more during the stability test compared to the 7-metal spinel oxide (4.7% ± 0.3% versus 12.2% ± 0.4% decrease in activity, respectively).
Overall, the 4-metal spinel oxide degraded more during the stability test compared to the 7-metal spinel oxide (4.7% ± 0.3% versus 12.2% ± 0.4% decrease in activity, respectively).
The decrease in catalytic activity (3.6%± 0.3%) was comparable to the 7-metal spinel oxide.

extraction_notes: The paper contains a typo in the stability results on page 8 where the values for 4-metal and 7-metal are swapped in the parentheses (4.7% ± 0.3% versus 12.2% ± 0.4% decrease in activity, respectively) compared to the correct assignment on page 1 (decrease in activity of only 4.7% versus 12.2% during 14 h of operation). The values have been extracted according to their correct assignments.
